note: Frozen before hybrid-1 was combined or scored on the locked test split. Committed and pushed before the run; the result is published whatever it is.

system.rule: Rules first. If the rules' interpretation is valid and retrieval returns at least one candidate, use it with no model call. Otherwise use the LLM's result if it is valid and returns at least one candidate. Otherwise keep the rules' result. Whole results only, never mixed by field.

how_it_runs: No system is rerun. hybrid-1 is built with `audit hybrid` from the two component reports that release 1 produced on this split. Both components are deterministic, so this equals a live hybrid run (tests/unit/test_hybrid.py checks live == combined). The component reports are pinned by hash below and must match before combining.

llm.model: Qwen3.5-4B Q4_K_M (GGUF sha256 pinned in release/manifest.json)
llm.decoding: greedy, temperature 0, top_k 1, seed 20261101, thinking off

data.annotator: the owner, one annotator, blind to system output

primary_metric.name: correct_proposal_candidates
primary_metric.definition: On answerable records: the critical interpretation (relation, distance, unit, direction, qualifiers) matches the annotation AND the top-ranked candidate is an acceptable GNIS ID.
primary_metric.comparison: hybrid-1 minus rules-1, paired by record, in percentage points of answerable records

analysis.interval: paired bootstrap over records, 10,000 resamples, seed 20261101, 95% percentile interval
analysis.test: exact two-sided sign test on discordant records
analysis.sensitivity: the same, excluding rows with an unsure (?) annotation; reported, not decisive

decision_rule.yes: difference >= +10 pp AND the 95% interval lower bound > 0
decision_rule.no: the 95% interval upper bound < +10 pp (the data rule the target out)

expectation_stated_in_advance: About +5 pp (dev and validation pooled: 48 against 43 of 92). The dev-data ceiling for any selection between these two systems is about +12 pp, so 'yes' is unlikely.
caveats: This is the second scoring of the locked test. The choice to try a rules-first hybrid was informed partly by release 1's published test totals (the LLM flagged more unsupported labels and reported more absent references). The selection rule itself was chosen on dev data only (eval/reports/hybrid-1-findings.md), and no per-record test output was read.
The components are unchanged from release 1, so the result is not independent of release 1: it measures how the same two outputs combine.
secondary_reported: the same metrics and paired comparison for hybrid-1 against the LLM alone
records gained and lost against the rules
references absent from GNIS reported absent
mean fields to correct per record
not_evaluable_for_this_release: The section 7 targets that need computed proposals (proposal correctness of ready_for_review records, useful coverage, containment with region size, reviewer time). Feature extent is unknown, so no system computes proposals.
run_rules: hybrid-1 is combined and scored once. A technical failure may be rerun with this declaration and is recorded; nothing is rerun because of its result.
Per-record outputs stay under eval/benchmark/test/reports/ and are never read during development. Only aggregate numbers are published in eval/reports/.
Any later change is a new release and needs a new declaration before the test is scored again.
